summary.en: Former president Joseph Kabila has created a new political-military front that includes the M23 rebels. Erik Prince's security personnel were attacked in eastern DR Congo, resulting in the death of a former New Zealand special forces officer and wounds to former UFC fighter Tim Kennedy. The ambush occurred as fighting around the M23 campaign intensified. An African Union panel is meeting President Tshisekedi in Kinshasa as part of shuttle diplomacy on the crisis. The UCDP recorded 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Tidligere president Joseph Kabila har opprettet en ny politisk-militær front som inkluderer M23-opprørerne. Erik Princes sikkerhetspersonell ble angrepet i Øst-DR Kongo, noe som førte til at en tidligere newzealandsk spesialstyrkeoffiser døde og at den tidligere UFC-utøveren Tim Kennedy ble såret. Bakholdet skjedde mens kampene rundt M23‑kampanjen intensiverte seg. Et panel fra Den afrikanske unionen møter president Tshisekedi i Kinshasa som en del av shuttlediplomati om krisen. UCDP registrerte 1 158 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
